sources.title: Boson AI Launches Higgs STT 3 Speech-to-Text Model
sources.snippet: Today, we are publicly releasing Higgs STT 3, a state-of-the-art Speech-to-Text (STT / ASR) foundation model. It supports 94 languages with sophisticated language detection, advanced sentiment and semantic understanding, and outperforms whisper-v3-large by a large margin on key languages.
